properties.name: CHANGELOG.md is the one record of what changed between versions, and no upgrade step a consumer must take is lost when the per-version upgrade notes retire
properties.statement:
The per-version upgrade notes (docs/upgrading-to-v0.x.md) retire. CHANGELOG.md is the one place a person reads what changed in each version. Where an upgrade asks a consumer to DO something (a migration, a required command, a verification before a swap, as v0.55.0's did), those steps are kept, in that version's CHANGELOG entry or on one upgrading page, and never only in git history. The CHANGELOG's versioning table stops saying a schema change "needs an upgrade doc" and says instead where required steps go. Upgrade notes registered as Artifacts retire on the record.

Anthony, 2026-09-28: "I don't think all the upgrading-to-v0.47.0.md type documents are needed (I believe https://github.com/sligara7/reflow2/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md captures all the fine grain changes)." Kept as intent from dec:idea-the-per-version-upgrade-notes-retire-into-the-changelog, with the counter-argument recorded there (v0.55.0's required migration) answered by the "no step is lost" clause.
